outline.purpose: Trace request, helper, schema, component, and persistence ownership only through packages/web/src/emails/weekly-digest.tsx:skills map,rankBadge,skill URL; packages/web/src/app/api/cron/weekly-digest/route.ts:topSkills projection. Parse each item's badge, title link, href, and tracking query. Assert one-based rank and utm_content stay aligned with the source array position. Cross-check the projected fields supplied by the cron query.

outline.heading: React email list rendering: Assertions and Diagnostics

outline.heading: What Regressions and Boundaries Prevent False Confidence?
outline.purpose: Ranking query correctness and rendered link correctness are separate contracts; this brief focuses on template output while linking to the query article. List nearby concerns owned by related articles and define the post-change cases that remain in scope.

outline.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
outline.purpose: Answer five to eight questions in 40 to 60 words each. Cover "How do you test rank badges, author-qualified routes, and rank-specific utm_content values for every digest skill?" plus question variants based on digest rank badge test, email skill order assertion, utm content skill rank, weekly digest author route, react email list rendering.

outline.heading: Conclusion
outline.purpose: Summarize the verified contract without introducing new claims, then use this CTA: Compare the leaderboard order with a rendered digest fixture and add per-rank link assertions.

briefs.coreQuestion: How do you prove that skill creation returns 201 before subscriber lookup or email delivery succeeds or fails?

outline.heading: Nonblocking skill alert dispatch tests: What Must the Suite Prove?
outline.purpose: Answer "How do you prove that skill creation returns 201 before subscriber lookup or email delivery succeeds or fails?" in 40 to 60 words, define the contract as skill creation must return 201 independently of subscriber lookup and email delivery because alert work runs on a detached promise, and state the observable pass criteria.

outline.heading: Which QASkills Code Paths Own This Contract?
outline.purpose: Trace request, helper, schema, component, and persistence ownership only through packages/web/src/app/api/skills/route.ts:POST detached subscriber promise; packages/web/src/lib/email/send.ts:sendNewSkillAlert. Separate code-backed behavior from source-backed recommendations.

outline.heading: Fire and forget email test: Baseline Cases
outline.purpose: Explain the normal path and compatibility boundaries for fire and forget email test. Convert repository branches into named fixtures with complete observable outputs.

outline.heading: Skill publish response timing: Test Matrix
outline.purpose: Compare skill insert outcome, response settlement time, subscriber lookup result, send result, logged failure, and client-visible status. Include the planned table, explain every row, and cite the repository source for each expected result.

outline.heading: How Should Email side effect isolation Be Exercised?
outline.purpose: Build the harness for email side effect isolation, identify which dependencies require real integration versus controlled doubles, and state the assertions that prevent false positives.

outline.heading: Step-by-Step Nonblocking resend dispatch Procedure
outline.purpose: Present the numbered procedure for nonblocking resend dispatch: Place deferred promises around subscriber lookup and alert sending. POST a valid skill and observe whether the 201 response settles before deferred work is released. Release success and failure outcomes, then assert logs and the unchanged response. Add a separate control proving insert failure still blocks the success response.

outline.heading: Post response background promise: Assertions and Diagnostics
outline.purpose: Cover post response background promise with status, state, side-effect, call-count, and visible-output assertions. Explain the failure signal a CI report must retain.

outline.heading: What Regressions and Boundaries Prevent False Confidence?
outline.purpose: Do not describe detached work as durable background execution; the test proves response isolation, not guaranteed completion after process shutdown. List nearby concerns owned by related articles and define the post-change cases that remain in scope.

outline.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
outline.purpose: Answer five to eight questions in 40 to 60 words each. Cover "How do you prove that skill creation returns 201 before subscriber lookup or email delivery succeeds or fails?" plus question variants based on fire and forget email test, skill publish response timing, email side effect isolation, nonblocking resend dispatch, post response background promise.

outline.heading: Conclusion
outline.purpose: Summarize the verified contract without introducing new claims, then use this CTA: Publish against a controlled test fixture and add response-timing assertions before changing alert dispatch.
